summary:
I wrote plan.md for both plots. Plot 0: Rockefeller Plaza street on the west and a 26 x 36 sunken well, using the lidar levels as given. Inside it are a 16 x 28 rink running north–south, glass-fronted restaurants lit warm under the north and south edges, umbrella terraces, and broad steps up to the gardens.
At the west end Prometheus is built in gold (gilded mount, a vertical ring, the figure flying horizontally with a glowing fire), set against a black granite wall with a gold zodiac ring and inscription. Around the well is a ring of 60 glowing white poles with mixed wool flags, all lit.
Plot 1: six turquoise-floored granite pools with bronze jets, flower and azalea planters, and walks that step up toward Fifth Avenue on three level terraces. Nothing was built or rendered yet; the toolkit doesn't know 1.21.1's `chain`, so swap it at delivery. Landscape kit with no buildings: a sunken ice-rink well with Prometheus against a dark zodiac wall, ringed by flags and glass-fronted restaurants. The Channel Gardens run east from it as six turquoise pools between flower planters.
elements.md and the PALETTE, VOCABULARY, ROOMS and PARTS sections are written. One palette fix: `polished_andesite_wall` doesn't exist in 1.21.1, so `andesite_wall` replaces it.

parts.name: ground
parts.scope: Terrain of both plots to the ground map (stone fill, half-step slabs, outer 2 blocks exact), the street, sidewalks, crosswalks, promenade field and bands, and the Channel Gardens terraces and walks. Uses groundColumn, halfStep, roadStrip, crosswalk, paverBand, promenadeField.

parts.name: sunken well
parts.scope: Plot 0 x20..45 z10..45: wellWall, rinkRim and packed_ice rink, gardenSteps x42..47 z20..33, planterBox at the stair head, restaurant glassFront and froglightBay, six umbrellas, parapet.

parts.name: prometheus
parts.scope: Wall x18..19 z18..37 y0..10 (darkWall), zodiacRing, inscriptionBand, basin and cascade x20..22 z20..35, goldMount, prometheus figure, goldRing.

parts.name: flags
parts.scope: flagPole ring: end_rod poles y5..11 every 2 blocks on the north (z7), south (z48), west (x17) and east (x48) lines, with mixed-colour 2x2 wool flags at y10..11.

parts.name: channel gardens
parts.scope: Plot 1: six pools P1..P6 with prismarine floor and copper jets, plantBed planters with flowers and shrubs, and benches at z3 and z12.

parts.name: lighting
parts.scope: lampPost at the listed positions on both plots, lanterns on parapet posts and rink rim, and a check that no ground cell is dark.

recruit.why: Paving, retaining walls, steps, pools and parapets in granite-toned stone, with correct courses and edges
Prometheus, the gold ring and the zodiac wall read as modelled gold against dark granite
Flower and shrub planters on soil, clipped azaleas, benches
Restaurant glass fronts, doors and umbrellas
Dusk lighting, lamp posts and lanterns, with no dark cells where mobs could spawn
The pole ring and its mixed national-colour flags
